name: Fli-1 proto-oncogene, ETS transcription factor
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: FLI1 encodes friend leukemia integration 1 transcription factor. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to bleeding disorder, platelet-type, 21 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Ewing sarcoma; Adamantinoma-like Ewing sarcoma of the head and neck. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
